## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and backbone agreement support InSitu with 0% invasive risk [F1] and clear margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 99%, Normal 1%, Benign 0%, Invasive 0% | Strong InSitu call, 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% target (10% alpha; 90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 96th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions, JPEG level 3 [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD, degraded |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent models share top class |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (80%) [F5]; nearest Invasive `BACH_0138` (82% similarity) | Reference neighbors mostly match InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.3, contribution -0.591) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (0.096, contribution -0.462) pushes away from invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Above-typical score (1.025, contribution -0.401); descriptive context only [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score (1.09, contribution -0.324) favors non-invasive tissue · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score 1.065 (contribution +0.315), but failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deleting top-risk regions drops invasive score more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197), showing classifier faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI crosses zero (-0.0088 to 0.0064, unverified); `mitoses` (0/20), `necrosis` (3/20), and `normal_lobules` (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion exists in region 11 (41% risk) or region 9, matching invasive neighbor `BACH_0138` (82% similarity).
- Severity-3 JPEG compression, 96th-percentile OOD shift, and blocked frozen-section stains mask invasion or borderline lateral margin involvement.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 11, 5, 9**: Inspect highest heatmap risk areas (41%, 4%, 2%) and stromal infiltration peak (region 9).
2. **Regions 3, 6, 8, 4**: Verify duct confinement, nuclear pleomorphism (region 3), and TILs (region 4) versus `BACH_0138`.
3. **Regions 3, 7, 8, 9**: Check lateral, inferior, medial, and superior surgical margins where segment scores approach threshold.
